description: Manages system-level administrative tasks, such as database migrations.

endpoints.name: RunMigrations
endpoints.description: Executes pending database migrations to update the system's schema. This is typically used for initial setup or system upgrades.
example_uses: Initialize the database schema for the first time.
Update the system's database to the latest version.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to execute pending database migrations, typically during system deployment, initial setup, or upgrade processes. This operation ensures the database schema is up-to-date with the application's requirements. It should be used with caution as it modifies the database structure.
